intervention: No compound: measurement of the parvalbumin interneuron population in neuron-targeted Wwox deletion, with cell number, identity and maturation, marker expression, intrinsic properties, synaptic input and circuit function read as six separate questions
question: In the neuron-targeted Wwox-deletion mouse, is the lower Pvalb transcript due to fewer parvalbumin interneurons, to immature or altered identity, to lower marker expression in a normal number of cells, to changed intrinsic properties, to less synaptic input onto or from them, or to a circuit-level change, and which of these is measured per animal?
why_now: It decides whether any parvalbumin-directed pharmacology, positive modulation or another kind, can be thought about at all, and which of the inhibitory-hypofunction contrasts to run first. Its direction is not assumed: raising parvalbumin-cell activity is not taken to be the right direction. It enters at rank 6 as a premise measurement because the nucleus-level route was closed by the replicate structure of the deposit and what remains is a per-animal measurement.
evidence_available: WWOX-system, transcript: a lower Pvalb transcript in the neuron-targeted deletion in bulk hippocampus (log2 -1.70, GSE158681 S contrast, as quoted in IT13b) and about half that size in the nuclear data (GSE158684: Pvalb 70 against 37 UMI in 3182 against 2920 nuclei; nuclei Pvalb share ratio 0.59). GSE158684 holds one pooled library per arm (library and animal index absent; the paper states n = 1 per arm), so nuclei are not biological replicates and the GSM records of the series are not independent experiments; PV-class nuclei number 12 to 19 per arm under the producer rules, the independent recompute disagrees on the specific counts, and PV composition and Pvalb per cell are undecidable under every rule tried. Kcnc1 is lower in inhibitory nuclei (one pool, not a replicate result). Immature-neuron markers (Sox11, Dcx, Igfbpl1) are higher in knockout neurons in direction; the larger composition change is oligodendrocyte-class nuclei, about 3- to 5-fold fewer. Wwox also falls in glia-called nuclei, unexplained. Protein and function, from the need file: PV-positive counts reduced by 44 percent in the whole hippocampus of a systemic constitutive knockout (PMID 30290271) and spontaneous inhibitory current amplitude more than halved in layer II/III pyramidal neurons of the neuron-specific knockout (PMID 34634460; pooled events, not animals). Raw reads of the eight snRNA experiments (SRX9206272 to SRX9206279) carried NCBI status hup on 2026-10-31. A conference abstract of the Nappi/Jiang programme was not found in this module by name search; no statement of it is carried here.
decisive_uncertainty: Which of the six layers moves, per animal. A lower transcript does not show fewer cells, lower activity or less inhibition; an absent change in GSE158684 is not evidence of no change; the oligodendrocyte-lineage shift could be consequence or cause of an excitation-inhibition change and the data cannot say which. Whether any parvalbumin-cell change is a deficit, a compensation or a delayed maturation is unresolved, so the need direction stays unresolved and no lever sign is derived.
next_test: Per-animal parvalbumin cell counts by immunostaining in neuron-targeted Wwox deletion against Cre-only controls, at least 3 animals per arm (reopening condition (c) of NP3A1), read together with a maturation and identity marker panel in the same animals, and, where the data holders allow, intrinsic-property and inhibitory-input recordings from labelled parvalbumin cells and a circuit-level read. Alternatives that also reopen it: a deposited library or animal index for GSE158684, or an independent neuron-targeted deletion dataset with at least 3 animals per arm and a parvalbumin-enriched capture. The result is read as six separate rows (number, identity and maturation, marker expression, intrinsic properties, synaptic input, circuit function); a change in one is not carried to another.
feasibility: Not executable from this module: no animals or tissue are held and the raw reads are not public. Feasible only by data holders or a new dataset; nothing is sent to anyone from here. Zero-spend preparation is limited to fixing the readout table before any data arrive.
novelty_perimeter: Queried on 2026-11-07: the IT13b, IT14 P1a and IT14 P1b records of this module, the NP3A1 row of the reopening table, and the need file; a name search of this module for a conference-abstract record of the Nappi/Jiang programme returned no record, so nothing is attributed to it. A search of this module, not a statement about the literature.
origin_detail: Known in the WWOX system: the parvalbumin marker deficit is already a named need observation and the NP3A1 reopening trigger; the row restates the open question as six separable layers (IT13b, IT14 P1a, IT14 P1b, reopening table row NP3A1).
evidence_solidity: Premise measurement: the transcript deficit is observed in bulk and in one nuclear pool per arm; cell number, identity, intrinsic properties, synaptic input and circuit function are not measured at animal level by any file read here
movement_note: New row, enters at rank 6. Reasons: it gates every parvalbumin-directed lever question and the order of the inhibitory-hypofunction contrasts. Not rewarded: novelty. A conference abstract of the Nappi/Jiang programme could change the evidence once a record of it is in the module; none is there now.

intervention: Class IIa-selective tool compound TMP269 against HDAC5 knockdown, with catalytic-dead and localisation-mutant HDAC5 rescue, a class-I-only inhibitor and an HDAC6 inhibitor as controls, in human neural cells
question: In human neural progenitors or neurons, does catalytic inhibition of class IIa HDACs lower the output of HDAC5 at SLC2A1 the way HDAC5 knockdown does, or does it leave it unchanged or raise it?
why_now: The HDAC5 to SLC2A1 thread rests on one muscle knockdown observation and has been carried as a limit, not a veto; the premise measurement it needs is the one open step of the IT28 challenge (WO-30). It sits at rank 7 because no neural line with the constructs is held and the readout does not change another row today.
evidence_available: Edge: HDAC5 to SLC2A1 traces to one origin, human primary muscle cells, where HDAC5 knockdown reduced GLUT1 expression (PMID 22991226, abstract level); the one drug tested there was pan-HDAC and was reported for GLUT4 only. Class IIa enzymes have very low intrinsic activity on standard substrates and repress largely as scaffolds; in neurons the separating experiments exist for HDAC4, not HDAC5; cardiomyocyte data show catalytic activity mattering for HDAC5 with the opposite sign (inhibition raises the output). Compound side: TMP269 identity confirmed by full InChIKey (CHEMBL3110004); ChEMBL values from one paper, HDAC4 130, HDAC5 80, HDAC7 40, HDAC9 20 nM, in a recombinant catalytic-domain assay, cross-paper values vary and whether each was measured or quoted was not checked; whether TMP269 engages HDAC5 in cells at the cited exposures is not determined. Attribution gap of the pan-class comparator in this thread: vorinostat is held on main_target_weak_attribution (HDAC5 Ki 3600 against HDAC1 1.3 nM, fold 2769.2), so an effect of that compound would read as class I. Counter-premise carried in the generator: class I and pan-HDAC inhibition are signed adverse for oligodendrocyte maturation; for class IIa the CNS sign is unknown, the only myelin datum is a peripheral Schwann-cell double mutant of Hdac4 and Hdac5 (PMID 29472387, partial full text), and WWOX neuron-deleted mice are hypomyelinated. WWOX-system: HDAC5 mRNA nominally lower and SLC2A1 nominally higher in the P47T mouse, an mRNA association only; the human organoid shows SLC2A1 higher on transcript.
decisive_uncertainty: Whether catalytic inhibition reproduces knockdown at SLC2A1 in a human neural cell: knockdown is not catalytic inhibition when the enzyme acts mostly as a scaffold. The premise is refuted if a catalytic-dead rescue restores SLC2A1 like wild type, if TMP269 leaves SLC2A1 unchanged while knockdown moves it, or if the effect of a class-I-only inhibitor is the same; if inhibition raises SLC2A1 the lever inverts. Potency of the broader HDAC compounds on HDAC5 cannot be compared until the methods of the three potency papers are readable (WO-29, data access blocked).
next_test: Step 1, no compound: HDAC5 knockdown in human neural progenitors or neurons reading SLC2A1 protein, glucose uptake and transcript, with rescue by wild type, a localisation mutant and a catalytic-site mutant. Step 2: TMP269, a class-I-only inhibitor and an HDAC6 inhibitor as negative control, with histone acetylation read as target engagement. A myelin-relevant readout (oligodendrocyte-precursor differentiation, with and without neuron conditioning) is proposed in IT29 P10 for the same experiment and was not seen on any ref.
feasibility: Wet-lab measurement; no neural line with the constructs is held in the module. As a drug question, no statement of CNS exposure of the compounds is carried here. A compound result on this row would be read as a premise result, never as evidence that any compound works.
novelty_perimeter: Queried on 2026-11-07: the IT28 P3 HDAC5 batch, the IT29 P10 question record, the IT29 P11 residue and TMP269 identity records, the IT22 P6 reverse record and rows WO-29 and WO-30 of the open-questions map. A search of this module, not a statement about the literature. The vorinostat thread is an already-known internal reference, not an independent source of support.
origin_detail: Generated by LEGEND (proposal IT21P2-0006 and the HDAC5 to SLC2A1 chain, harm arm Q2); challenge CH-IT28-HDAC5-LEVER concluded NARROWED, not refuted, not confirmed; the vorinostat row is an earlier internal case of the same chain, reached before this premise was examined.
evidence_solidity: Conditional hypothesis: the edge has one muscle origin read at abstract level and the compound side is compiled data; no catalytic-dead or localisation datum for HDAC5 exists in a neural cell in the files read
movement_note: New row, enters at rank 7. Reasons: it is the one open measurement of the IT28 challenge and it keeps or refutes the premise carried on 23 proposals as a limit. Not rewarded: novelty. Status stays conditional; the myelin counter-premise is a separate open question (CH-IT29-CLASSIIA-CNS-MYELIN).
